summary: HiTek Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing a Share Purchase Agreement dated August 3, 2026, to acquire all issued shares of Ju Fu Limited from seller Mai Thi My Ut. Ju Fu, via subsidiaries Fourth Coco Technology Limited and Beijing Fourth Coco Technology, operates an advertising and digital marketing business under the Beijing Fourth Coco brand. Total consideration is US$20,000,000: US$14,000,000 in cash (staged, deferred, performance-based) plus 4,000,000 Class A ordinary shares valued at US$6,000,000, subject to adjustment and performance-based lock-up/leak-out/forfeiture provisions. The acquisition closes in two tranches within 10 and 60 days from August 3, 2026, subject to conditions. No advisors or board recommendation noted. Watch for closing milestones and performance-target achievement affecting deferred consideration.
